name: Hearthglow Tonic
description: Warmth and healing in one gulp. Tastes like a fireside hug.

name: Slumber Syrup
description: Calm, then sleep, then a dream about a very polite owl.

name: Valour Cordial
description: Courage with a cool head, for anything spooky. Side effect: heroic posing.

name: Moonbloom Draught
description: Makes things grow in cold, cursed or night-time places. Turnips may get chatty.

name: Stillwater Draught
description: Calm in a bottle. One sip and even a thunderstorm says sorry.

name: Dewdrop Balm
description: Cools, soothes, mends. Gargle twice, then compose a short poem about mornings.

name: Nightfire Punch
description: Courage for things that go bump. Bump back, politely.

name: Greenthumb Syrup
description: Pure growth. Keep away from moustaches unless a hedge is the goal.

name: Nocturne Syrup
description: Sleep so deep that dreams send a postcard instead of visiting.

name: Steamwhistle Tonic
description: Fire and frost argue in the bottle until they agree on steam. Clears the head, whistles.

name: Bonfire Tonic
description: Pure blazing courage. Toasts marshmallows held near the drinker's ears.

name: Smoulder Syrup
description: Warmth for long, spooky nights. Keeps a ghost-hunter cosy and slightly dramatic.

name: Embermoss Elixir
description: Ground moss, roaring fire, one cool thought. For heroes who face curses before breakfast.

name: Panacea
description: A little of everything, in perfect balance. The Guild calls it the true test of a brewer.

name: Hushfire Tonic
description: Keeps an inner fire warm but very, very quiet. Popular with dragons, who deny it.

name: Duskbloom Syrup
description: Heals while you sleep and lifts small curses by morning. Tastes of lavender and secrets.

name: Starfire Elixir
description: Ground starlight with a brave spark. Makes the drinker glow at parties, literally.
